name: Europower Enerji ve Otomasyon Teknolojileri Sanayi Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
summary: Europower Enerji ve Otomasyon Teknolojileri Sanayi Ticaret Anonim Sirketi designs, develops, manufactures, and sells electrical system products in Turkey. The company offers medium and low voltage products, compact substations, PFC systems, railway products, silicone insulators, as well as oil type distribution, medium power, and special type transformers. It also provides various services, such as project design, project management, automation and scada, supervision, and training services. In addition, the company offers laboratory and field tests, measurement, analysis and reporting of electrical power, as well as engineering and commissioning services.
